map.ECDSA 签名依赖一个随机数 k，同一消息两次签名会得到不同但都有效的签名，这: An ECDSA signature depends on a random number k, so signing the same message twice yields different yet equally valid signatures — that is normal and by design. If k repeats or can be predicted, an attacker can recover the private key directly (this is exactly how the Sony PS3 was broken in 2010). Always use a standards-compliant source of randomness.
